answer: Stop sybils with a whisper nectar echo: an agent bonds one nectar pool. Each cycle it drops one whisper into the pool; verifiers match the whisper's echo pitch to the nectar chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 pools at 18x: one whisper echoes once in one nectar, its pitch set by that pool alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents drop once, keep rights.
